title: 第28章 八卦第29章 真神
slug: 诡秘星轨交织的夜第222章
content_zh:
“呃……巴德布这是？”克莱恩身体微微一僵，有些无措地看向莫甘娜。
莫甘娜看着巴德布这番叛变的举动，脸上依旧是一贯的笑容，只是淡淡解释了一句，“他很喜欢你，之前他可不亲近人，你可以摸摸他，他应该会开心的。”
“他？”
克莱恩低头看了看巴德布，明白了，巴德布是非凡动物，称呼一声他，应该没有问题。
既然“受害者”自己送上了门，且主人家也同意了，克莱恩不再客气，伸出手，试探性地轻轻落在巴德布的头顶。
小家伙非但没有躲闪，反而从喉咙里发出了极其响亮的、满足的“咕噜咕噜”声，甚至主动仰起头，蹭了蹭他的手指。
车厢内，除了巴德布享受的呼噜声，一时有些安静。
克莱恩顺着撸猫的动作，抬眼看向对面安静坐着的莫甘娜，找了个话题打破沉默，
“说起来，莫甘娜，我有点好奇……你怎么会想到养……嗯，巴德布这样的……猫？”克莱恩斟酌着用词，顾念外面的马车夫，并没有把话说的很明白。
莫甘娜的视线原本落在窗外流动的风景上，闻言转了回来，落在克莱恩腿上那团毫无防备、舒服得快要融化的毛球上。
她的目光似乎柔和了极其细微的一度，“他是父亲带回来给我的礼物。”
“啊？”克莱恩没想到会得到如此……朴素的答案，原来只是这样吗？还以为是需要什么机缘巧合，譬如像正义小姐一样意外服下魔药，又或者是意外碰到非凡动物之后利用实力驯服等等，克莱恩想了许多的可能，就是没有想到居然就是这样的简单。
不过，克莱恩也只是一时兴起询问而已，目前并没有想要获得同款的意思，只是顺着话头笑道，“他很可爱。”
说着，克莱恩低头看着巴德布，小家伙正用脑袋顶着他的手心，一副“不要停，继续”的架势。
“巴德布不是乖巧的，有的时候我会几天见不到他，之前还会带他一起出去，可是他总是到处乱跑，我只能将他送回去。”莫甘娜看着巴德布，陈述道。
“活泼一点也不错，”克莱恩安慰道，“要是有点一不愿意动，他就不愿意陪你出去了。”
“你说的是也，还是活泼一点好。”莫甘娜只淡淡的说着，很快就换了一个话题，“你今天觉得怎么样？”
“啊？”克莱恩很明显没有想莫甘娜会询问这件事，迷茫地抬起头。
“听伦纳德说你们今天来了一位不速之客，有些儿好奇而已。”
虽然这个解释有点牵强，但是想到今天的功臣维斯珀先生是莫甘娜的父亲，克莱恩大致就明白了，莫甘娜应该是担心维斯珀先生，“确实有一个人出现了，不过，维斯珀先生很厉害，并没有什么事情发生，一切都很顺利，莫甘娜，你不用担心。”

“我知道的，我主要是为你担忧，据我所知的，优秀的占卜家，前期都需要大量的积累。”
莫甘娜的话说的极其隐晦，顾及到马车夫可能听到他们的对话，为了避免非凡世界暴露，莫甘娜只能用这样的话语来说。
作为一生都在做阅读理解的大吃货国人，克莱恩听明白了，这是在安慰自己，你现在看着确实没有什么能力，但是请你不要灰心，之后什么都会有的，现在你需要的就是等等。
他抬起头，对上莫甘娜平静的视线，自嘲地笑了笑，“说实话，我已经做好沉淀的准备了。”尤其是看到莫甘娜序列7还被定义为文职的时候，但是这句话有点得罪人，克莱恩只能咽下不说。

"Uh... what's Badbu?" Klein stiffened slightly and looked at Morgana at a loss.
Morgana looked at Badbu's rebellious behavior with her usual smile on her face. She just explained lightly, "He likes you very much. He didn't get close to others before. You can touch him and he should be happy."
"Him?"
Klein looked down at Badbu and understood that Badbu was an extraordinary animal. There should be no problem in calling him.
Now that the "victim" had arrived at the door by himself and the host had agreed, Klein stopped being polite and stretched out his hand, tentatively and gently landed on Badb's head.
Not only did the little guy not dodge, but he made an extremely loud and satisfied "gurgling" sound from his throat, and even took the initiative to raise his head and rub his fingers.
In the carriage, except for Badbu's snoring of enjoyment, it was quiet for a while.
Klein followed the action of petting the cat, looked up at Morgana who was sitting quietly opposite, and found a topic to break the silence.
"Speaking of which, Morgana, I'm a little curious... How did you think of raising... um, a... cat like Badbu?" Klein considered his words, thinking about the coachman outside, and didn't make his words very clear.
Morgana's eyes originally fell on the flowing scenery outside the window, but after hearing this, she turned back and landed on the defenseless ball of fur on Klein's legs, which was so comfortable that it was about to melt.
Her eyes seemed to soften slightly, "He was a gift brought back to me by my father."
"Ah?" Klein didn't expect to get such a...simple answer. Is it just like this? He thought it was some kind of coincidence, such as accidentally taking a magic potion like Miss Justice, or accidentally encountering an extraordinary animal and then using his strength to tame it, etc. Klein thought about many possibilities, but he didn't expect it to be so simple.
However, Klein only asked on a whim. He had no intention of getting the same model at the moment. He just smiled along with the words, "He is very cute."
As he spoke, Klein looked down at Badb. The little guy was pressing his head against his palm, with a "don't stop, keep going" attitude.
"Badbu is not well-behaved. Sometimes I won't see him for several days. I would take him out with me before, but he always runs around, so I can only send him back." Morgana looked at Badbu and stated.
"It's not bad to be lively," Klein comforted. "If you're a little unwilling to move, he won't be willing to go out with you."
"You're right, it's better to be more lively." Morgana said lightly and quickly changed the topic, "How do you feel today?"
"Ah?" Klein obviously didn't expect Morgana to ask about this matter, and he raised his head in confusion.
"I heard from Leonard that you have an uninvited guest here today. I'm just a little curious."
Although this explanation is a bit far-fetched, after thinking that Mr. Vesper, today's hero, is Morgana's father, Klein roughly understood that Morgana should be worried about Mr. Vesper. "A person did appear, but Mr. Vesper is very powerful. Nothing happened. Everything went smoothly. Morgana, you don't have to worry."
"I know, I'm mainly worried about you. As far as I know, an excellent diviner needs a lot of accumulation in the early stage."
Morgana's words were extremely cryptic. Considering that the carriage driver might hear their conversation, in order to avoid exposing the extraordinary world, Morgana could only use such words.
As a Chinese foodie who has been doing reading comprehension all his life, Klein understands that this is to comfort himself. It seems that you really have no ability now, but please don't be discouraged. Everything will be available in the future. All you need now is to wait.
He raised his head, met Morgana's calm gaze, and smiled self-deprecatingly, "To be honest, I haveBe prepared to settle. "Especially when you see that Morgana's Sequence 7 is still defined as a civilian, but this sentence is a bit offensive, so Klein can only swallow it and say nothing.
